headline: GlowberryClient — Crash Fix & Native Mod Restore
summary: The startup crash from the preloader's memory allocator is fixed, and every inbuilt mod — Gyro, Zoom, FPS, AutoSprint and the rest — loads and runs again.

items.text: Fixed a startup crash caused by the preloader replacing malloc/free with an allocator that cannot free memory it did not allocate.
The process now keeps the system allocator, which is what the Optifine "Allocator" toggle requested in the first place.
Restored the native hook entry point the bundled inbuilt-mods library imports, so it loads instead of failing silently with no implementation.
Gyro, Zoom, FPS, AutoSprint and the other inbuilt mods now load and run again.
The bundled preloader is updated: no allocator interposition, and the older hook ABI is exported again so prebuilt mod libraries stay loadable.
